# Health Mental

> A comprehensive medical information directory providing health conditions, disease references, and symptom guides across multiple countries and healthcare settings.

Health Mental serves as a global health information hub with localized content for major English-speaking and European countries. The site aggregates medical conditions, disease directories, and healthcare facility information to help users understand health topics and locate relevant medical resources.

## Key Topics

- Medical Conditions
- Disease Directory
- Health Information
- Symptom Guide
- Medical Reference
- Health Conditions
- Disease Reference
- Condition Index
- Health Categories
- Regional Health Information
- Healthcare Facilities
- Medical Equipment
- Sports Medicine
- Wellness
- Reproductive Health

## Core Resources

- [Health Mental Homepage](https://www.health-mental.org): Main health information directory and medical encyclopedia
- [Health Information Hub](https://www.health-mental.org/health): Central health information hub with medical conditions directory and disease categories

## Regional Health Guides

- [USA Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/usa): Regional health information and medical conditions guide for the United States
- [Canada Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/canada): Regional health information and disease reference for Canada
- [UK Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/uk): Regional health information and disease directory for the United Kingdom
- [Australia Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/australia): Regional health information and medical directory for Australia
- [Germany Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/germany): Regional health information and medical conditions for Germany
- [France Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/france): Regional health information and disease directory for France
- [Spain Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/spain): Regional health information and medical categories for Spain
- [Mexico Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/mexico): Regional health information and disease directory for Mexico

## Healthcare Facilities & Providers

- [Medical Center Information](https://www.health-mental.org/medical-center): Medical center information with health conditions and disease resources
- [Hospital Directory](https://www.health-mental.org/hospital): Hospital information with health conditions and symptom guide resources
- [Doctor Directory](https://www.health-mental.org/doctor): Doctor directory with health conditions and medical reference information
- [Pharmacy Information](https://www.health-mental.org/pharmacy): Pharmacy information and medical reference for health conditions

## Medical Conditions & Health Topics

- [Allergies](https://www.health-mental.org/allergies): Allergies health information with symptom guide and disease directory
- [Acne](https://www.health-mental.org/acne): Acne health conditions information and medical reference guide
- [ACL Injuries](https://www.health-mental.org/acl-injuries): ACL injuries sports medicine information and health reference guide
- [Aging](https://www.health-mental.org/aging): Aging health information with wellness guide and disease directory

## Optional Resources

- [Medical Equipment](https://www.health-mental.org/equipment): Medical equipment information with health conditions and disease reference
- [Abortion Health Information](https://www.health-mental.org/abortion): Abortion health information and medical guide with disease reference
